start.title: Your financing request in a few minutes.
start.lead: Answer a few questions. We tell you right away which documents are needed – and then read them for you.
start.advisor.title: HYPOTEQ advisor
start.advisor.sub: I am submitting the request on behalf of a client.
start.client.title: Client
start.client.sub: I am submitting my own financing request.
start.claim: Thanks to HYPOTEQ, mortgages have become comparable. Your advisor, however, is unique.®
start.mode.fast.title: Quick start
start.mode.fast.sub: I already have the documents. Upload the folder – we fill in the rest.
start.mode.guided.title: Guided request
start.mode.guided.sub: A few questions. We tell you right away which documents are needed.
start.leadModes: With or without documents. We tell you right away what is needed – and read the rest for you.
start.mode.fast.text: I already have the documents. Upload first – then most of the request is filled in.
start.mode.fast.duration: approx. 3 minutes · much of it pre-filled

side.toFast: Documents ready? Switch to quick start

step.why.fast.upload: Upload the folder – we read everything

s1.title: New financing request
s1.lead: A few details on the request – on the right you see right away which documents follow from them.
s1.advisorEmailHint: That’s all we need – we recognise you by your address.
s1.noPartner.title: Not a partner yet?
s1.noPartner.text: We don’t know this address yet. Register in one minute – then the request continues as usual.
s1.noPartner.note: HYPOTEQ checks your details and will get in touch if there are questions. You can already enter the request now.
s1.lookupFailed.title: Check not possible right now
s1.lookupFailed.text: We could not check this address just now. You can continue anyway – HYPOTEQ assigns the request when it arrives.
s1.contactNote: That’s all for now – we read date of birth, address and marital status from your documents.
s1.companyHr: Company as in the commercial register

q.nbDocs: Are the land register extract and building insurance policy already available?
q.nbDocs.hint: Often not yet for new builds – we will ask for them later.
q.heizung.hint: For possible green conditions from the banks. “Unknown” is fine – we check it in the documents.
q.baurecht: Is the property held under a building right?
q.reno: Are there renovations or costs on top of the purchase price?
q.job.hint: Self-employed people submit annual accounts instead of salary certificates.
q.ab50.hint: If yes: AHV pension forecast and pillar 3 values.
q.kredite.hint: Personal loans are reported to the ZEK credit bureau. Stating them early avoids queries from the bank.
q.buerge: Is a joint and several guarantee needed?
q.s3a.hint: If yes: certificate and policy incl. value statement.
q.chips.hint: Nothing selected means: does not apply.

s2.title: What are we financing?
s2.lead: Each answer determines which documents we need later. Nothing has to be entered twice.
s2.fromDocs: We read the address, year of construction and land register data from the documents later.
s2.existingMortgageHint: We read the bank, product and maturity date from the interest statement.
s2.purposePh: What will the increase be used for?
s2.valueIsPrice: Equals the purchase price – only change if different
s2.bauprojektOff: A construction project is not possible for refinancing.

s3.title: Who is financing?
s3.lead: We need the same documents per borrower. Additional questions only add to the list if they apply.
s3.incomeHint: We read date of birth, address and employer from the ID and salary certificate.
s3.companyName: Company name as per commercial register
s3.jpNote: We read the UID, registered office and signing authority from the commercial register extract.

s4.title: Financing
s4.valueHint: Estimate, last purchase price or market value
s4.affHint: Imputed 5 % interest, amortisation, 1 % running costs · max. 33 %
s4.equityVia: Does part of the equity come from …
s4.commentsPh: Anything else the bank should know
s4.lead: You see the loan-to-value and affordability right away. Equity questions stay on No until you change them.

s5.title: Upload documents
s5.lead: All at once, in any order. HYPOTEQ recognises each document, assigns it and reads the relevant details.
s5.dropSub: PDF, JPG, PNG. Whole folders are fine. You don’t need to say which document is which.
s5.drop2: Drop single files or a whole folder here
s5.dropSub2: Single documents or a whole folder with all documents. PDF, JPG, PNG. You don’t need to say which document is which.

doc.fotos: Photos of the property (interior and exterior)
doc.stwe_plan: Building / floor plans incl. net living area
doc.grundbuch: Current land register extract (max. 6 months old)
doc.gvz: Current building insurance policy (incl. cubic volume)
doc.projekt: Project plans, construction description and contract incl. cost summary and cubic volume
doc.stwe_regl: Deed of establishment with value quotas · use and management regulations
doc.mieterspiegel: Current tenancy schedule incl. rental income
doc.lohnausweise: Salary certificates for the last 3 years
doc.abschluss_se: Balance sheet and income statement (incl. audit report) for the last 3 years
doc.wb: Passport / ID of the authorised signatory
doc.jahresabschluss: Annual accounts (balance sheet and income statement) for the last 3 years
doc.pkvorbezug: Confirmation of pension fund withdrawal / pledge
doc.reno_liste: List of renovations (amount and location, e.g. kitchen, bathroom, façade)
doc.lohnausweise_alt: Salary certificates for the two previous years
doc.erbe1: Advance on inheritance / certificate of inheritance

sug.loan.title: We recognised a loan or lease agreement.
sug.loan.text: Your answer for “personal loans” or “leases” is No. Should it be set to Yes?
sug.maint.title: We recognised a maintenance agreement.
sug.maint.text: Your answers on children and maintenance payments are No. Should both be set to Yes?
sug.3a.title: We recognised pillar 3a documents.
sug.3a.text: Your answer for “pillar 3a” is No. Should it be set to Yes?
sug.stwe.title: We recognised condominium documents.
sug.stwe.text: The property is not recorded as a condominium. Should the type be changed?
sug.loan.chipText: Neither “Personal loan” nor “Lease” is ticked. Should it be added?
sug.maint.chipText: “Maintenance payments” is not ticked. Should it be added?
sug.3a.amountText: Surrender value according to the policy: {amount}. Should it be entered under pension assets?
sug.3a.enterText: No amount is entered for “Pillar 3a”. Enter the amount under own funds.

docs.progressBusy: You can carry on – the list updates itself.
docs.uploadLost: The page was reloaded before the file had uploaded. Please choose it again.
docs.x.full: This requirement is already complete – kept in the case file, not counted.
docs.x.period: Not from the requested years ({years}) – kept in the case file, not counted.
docs.x.duplicate: Same content as {name} – not stored twice.
docs.x.notneeded: Not required for the financing review.
docs.x.offList: Does not match any requirement of your answers – kept in the case file.
docs.x.offListSug: Does not match any requirement of your answers – see the note above.
docs.x.dismissed: Not used – does not match any requirement of your answers.
docs.x.unknown: We could not tell what kind of document this is. Please assign it.
docs.x.failed: The file could not be read. Please assign it.
docs.x.person: We could not tell whose document this is. Please assign it.
docs.old.maxAge: Older than {months} months (document date {date}). The bank needs a current document.
docs.old.year: Not current (year {year}). The bank needs the current document.
docs.old.expired: Expired on {date}. Please upload a valid document.
docs.old.generic: This document is no longer current. The bank needs a current one.
docs.overridden: Used anyway – the bank will be told.
docs.noFields: No details were read from this document.
docs.caseLater: The case number («HQ-…») is assigned when you complete the request.
docs.toast.extra: {n} file(s) not needed or surplus – kept, not counted
docs.toast.type: {name}: PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC or WebP only
docs.internMeta: Thresholds 90 / 70 % · percentages and audit trail are internal only
docs.audit.aiOff: Automatic recognition is switched off on this environment
docs.x.olderSalary: Older salary certificate – only needed with variable pay. Kept in the dossier.
docs.toast.grew: The list has grown: {n} document(s) from the document analysis

s6.titleOk: We can finance this. On to the bank.
s6.title: Final look at the request
s6.leadMissing: Almost done – {n} document(s) still missing. The case can still be submitted; missing documents will follow.
s6.leadOk: All details and documents are complete.
s6.fromDocsLine: {n} details extracted instead of asked · {m} confirmed manually
s6.submitText: On submission, the case goes to HYPOTEQ for the bank request. The case dossier summarises all details and documents for the lender.
s6.doneSub: {name} will receive a confirmation at {email}. The dossier is ready for the bank request.
s6.toPortalLogin: Sign in to the partner portal
s6.leadReview: Loan-to-value or affordability needs a review by HYPOTEQ. The case can still be submitted.
s6.err.submit: The request could not be submitted. Please try again.
s6.err.network: No connection to HYPOTEQ. Please check your internet connection and try again.
s6.err.invalid: The request was not accepted. Please check the details in the previous steps.
s6.err.upload: “{name}” could not be uploaded. Please upload it again under “Documents” or remove it.
s6.err.uploadPending: Files are still uploading. Please wait a moment and try again.
s6.err.dossier: The dossier could not be created. Please try again.
s6.finishBlockedHint: Upload the signed authorisation or choose “Submit later”.

rail.title: Your documents
rail.text: documents are needed for this request. The list only grows with your answers.

val.email: Please enter a valid email address.
val.amount: Please enter an amount in CHF.

em.title: Equity – breakdown
em.sub: Only fill in what applies. Each amount requests the matching document.
em.hardMin: at least 10 % of the purchase price required
em.subAbl: Existing pillar 3a or pledge – transferred to the new bank with the refinancing.

calc.byPrice: Max. 80 % of the lower of purchase price and estimated value
calc.incNote: Affordability appears once income is entered.

fast.s1.title: Quick start
fast.s1.lead: Just the email addresses. We read name, salutation and date of birth from the ID.
fast.s2.lead: Single documents or a whole folder. The request fills itself on the right while we read.
fast.rail.title: Your request is filling in
fast.rail.text: details taken from your documents. No need to type them.
fast.s3.title: Review and complete
fast.s3.lead: Everything in the documents is already filled in. Only the details below are missing.
fast.openSub: This is not in any document.
fast.extra: Also recognised · for confirmation email and Salesforce
fast.prefill: {n} details pre-filled from your documents – marked “from document”. Please review and complete.
fast.allComplete: All documents are complete. Nothing is missing.
fast.rail.empty: Nothing read yet – upload your documents on the left.

nn.vermoegen: Proof of equity is only needed for a purchase.
nn.hyp_sicher: Mortgage note / security agreement is not needed.
nn.hyp_rahmen: For refinancing we need the current product agreement.
nn.anstellung: Only needed for a pay rise in the current year – none detected.

sig.title: HYPOTEQ information authorisation · required
sig.notSignedSub: Required for every case. The authorisation is pre-filled with your details.
sig.pending: Signature pending · reminder after 2 and 5 days
sig.modalText: I authorise HYPOTEQ to obtain the information required for the financing from banks, insurers and authorities.
sig.uploadSub: Required for every case. Download the template, have all borrowers sign it, upload it here.
sig.step1Sub: Pre-filled with the details of this request.
sig.step2Sub: By {name} – by all borrowers if there are several.
sig.laterSub: The case is submitted as “signature pending”. No request goes to the bank without a signature.
sig.unsignedSub: The uploaded authorisation is not signed. Please upload a signed copy.
sig.wrongName: The name on the authorisation does not match the borrower.
sig.laterNote: The pre-filled template comes with the confirmation e-mail. Reminders follow after 2 and 5 days.
sig.analysingSub: Form, signature and name are being checked.
sig.wrongForm: The uploaded file is not a HYPOTEQ information authorisation.
sig.override: Submit anyway – HYPOTEQ will check it manually
sig.overrideHint: The AI check is only a hint. You can still finish the request – HYPOTEQ checks the authorisation by hand.
sig.overrideUndo: Do not submit it like this
sig.reviewSub: Submitted anyway – HYPOTEQ checks the authorisation by hand. You can still upload a signed copy.
sig.downloadError: The template could not be created. Please try again.
sig.step2SubJp: By {name} – authorised to sign for the company.
sig.toastChecking: Signature being checked · filed in the case folder and in Salesforce
sig.nr.title: Sign the information authorisation
sig.nr.sub: Download the template, have all borrowers sign it and upload it here – as a PDF or photo. No request goes to the bank without a signature.
sig.nr.ready: Will be sent with the documents.
sig.reminder.subject: Reminder: please sign the information authorisation
sig.reminder.subject2: Second reminder: please sign the information authorisation
sig.reminder.body: The signed information authorisation for your financing request{ref} is still missing. Without a signature we cannot send a request to a bank.
sig.reminder.steps: The pre-filled template is attached: print it, have all borrowers sign it and upload it via the link – as a PDF or photo.
sig.reminder.stepsNoAttachment: You will find the pre-filled template via the link: download it, have all borrowers sign it and upload it there – as a PDF or photo.
sig.reminder.already: Already uploaded? Then you can ignore this reminder.
sig.nr.step1Sub: Blank form – the pre-filled template is attached to our e-mail.

head.fast.anfrage.title: Your request
head.fast.anfrage.lead: Pre-filled from your documents. Check the details and add what is missing.
head.guided.objekt.lead: Property and financing on one page. You see the loan-to-value and affordability right away.
head.fast.objekt.lead: Pre-filled from your documents. Add what is not in any document.
head.guided.personen.lead: The same documents for each borrower. Additional points only extend the list if they apply.
head.fast.personen.lead: Pre-filled from the ID, salary statement and tax return. Check the additional points.
head.guided.abschluss.lead: Single documents or a whole folder with all documents – in any order. HYPOTEQ recognises every document, assigns it and reads out the details.
head.fast.abschluss.lead: Only what was missing from your folder – added by your answers or not recognised. Upload it one by one or submit it later.
